Package json implements encoding and decoding of JSON as defined in RFC 7159. The mapping between JSON and Go values is described in the documentation for the Marshal and Unmarshal functions. See JSON and Go for an introduction to this package. Security Considerations See the "Security Considerations" section in encoding/json/v2.
